DNSMSG
Description
These commands allow you process DNS responses from RESOLVER::name_lookup
Command List
DNSMSG::header
- returns a field from header of a DNS message.
DNSMSG::record
- returns a field from a DNS resource record object.
DNSMSG::section
- returns a section of a DNS message.
RESOLVER
- allow you to resolve names and addresses using the DNS
subsystem
